get.summary: Latest shared position of each person, for the manager map.
get.description:
Needs the MGRLOCHIS function code. Returns only LOCATION_SHARE points that are shared and fresh; a person whose
newest point is not shared does not appear. Supports ETag with 304 and a `since` cursor for delta polling
(LLD 4.3). Population scope and names from the user directory are not built yet.

parameters.name: clientId
parameters.description: Limits the result to one client. Ignored when the caller's client is known.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma separated list of LOCATION_SHARE, CHECK_IN, AEC. Only LOCATION_SHARE is returned by this layer.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Return only points captured after this time (use `nextSince` from the previous response).

get.summary: A person's shared location history, newest first.
get.description:
Own history needs USRLOCHIS; another person's needs MGRLOCHIS (population scope is not enforced yet) and is
audited. Only LOCATION_SHARE points are returned, never not-shared ones, and none captured before the person's
visibility fence (set when consent is revoked). An empty result is 200 with no points.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: 1h (default), 24h, 7d or 14d, capped at the retention window.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, capped by the server.

get.summary: A person's timeline: location shares merged with check-ins and AECs, oldest first.
get.description:
Same authorisation and audit as history. Sources are read in parallel; when one fails the others are still
returned with `partial: true` and the failed `failedSources`. Only the location share source exists
so far; check-ins and AECs come from other services.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: 1h (default), 24h, 7d or 14d, capped at the retention window.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, capped by the server.

get.summary: The effective policy for the caller: whether sharing is allowed now and what the device should do.
get.description:
The device refreshes this at foreground, login, token refresh, location wake-ups, the heartbeat and
`nextEvaluationAt` (LLD 3.3). Supports ETag with 304.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: The device's IANA time zone. Used for schedule windows before the person's home zone.

put.summary: Grants or revokes consent to share live location.
put.description:
GRANTED needs the current disclosure version (see `disclosureVersion` in the policy) and a client that
allows sharing. REVOKED takes effect at once (ADR-005): ingestion returns 403 CONSENT_REQUIRED, the person's
earlier points stop being visible and their latest position is deleted. Repeating a request changes nothing.
Returns the new policy.

put.summary: Reports the phone's location permission and time zone for this device.
put.description:
The session is ACTIVE only with the ALWAYS permission and precise location on; otherwise it is
SUSPENDED_OS_PERMISSION (ADR-005). Consent is not affected. Each call renews the sharing lease.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The device id, the same as `device.id` on points.

delete.description: Other devices are not affected (ADR-008). Safe to repeat. Returns 204.

put.summary: Sets the person's sharing type, home time zone and schedule.
put.description:
The type must be one the client offers. SCHEDULE needs at least one weekly window (local time, day 0 =
Sunday; an end before the start crosses midnight). The schedule is kept when another type is chosen, and a
change takes effect immediately. Returns the new policy.

post.summary: Submits 1 to 100 location points from the Assistance App.
post.description:
Returns 200 with a per-point result. The device deletes points reported as Stored, Duplicate or
Rejected (LLD 4.1). A batch that is empty, too large or has no device id is rejected as a whole with 400.
Live-sharing points (`shared: true`) are checked against the person's policy: when the client has not
enabled sharing, or the person has not consented, a batch of only live points gets 403 SHARING_NOT_ALLOWED or
CONSENT_REQUIRED with the current policy. In a mixed batch those points are rejected one by one instead.
A point captured before consent or the visibility fence, or outside the chosen sharing window, is rejected.
Not-shared points (AEC and Location Based Alerts only) are never checked against sharing consent.

disclosureVersion.description: Required for GRANTED: the version of the disclosure the person accepted.

state.description: ACTIVE, or SUSPENDED_OS_PERMISSION when the OS permission is not enough to share.

leaseExpiresAt.description: When the sharing lease ends unless the device reports again.

range.description: The requested range, one of 1h, 24h, 7d, 14d (capped at the retention window).

from.description: Start of the window actually applied.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

firstName.description: Null until the user directory is wired in.

lastName.description: Null until the user directory is wired in.

capturedAt.description: When the device captured the point.

freshnessSeconds.description: Age of the point at the time of the request.

nextSince.description: Pass as `since` on the next poll to receive only newer points.

id.description: Point id (a location share) or the source's own id.

accuracyM.description: Null when the source does not have it.

courseDeg.description: Degrees clockwise from true north. Null when unknown.

pointId.description: Generated on the device. With the party and capture time it makes a retry idempotent.

capturedAt.description: When the device captured the point (not when it was uploaded).

utcOffsetMinutes.description: Local time offset from UTC at capture, in minutes (India is 330). Used for schedule rules.

speed.description: Ground speed in metres per second. Omit when unknown.

course.description: Direction of travel in degrees clockwise from true north (0 = north, 90 = east), 0 to 360. Omit when unknown or stationary.

mockLocation.description: True when the OS reports a simulated location. Stored as a quality flag.

shared.description:
Required. True when live location sharing is on for this point: it is added to the history
    managers can see and becomes the latest position. False when the point was captured only for AEC or Location
    Based Alerts ("not shared"): it is never added to history and only replaces the latest position when it is newer.

PointStatus.description:
Stored: accepted. Duplicate: the same point was already stored. Superseded: a not-shared point that is not newer
than the latest position, so it was dropped. Rejected: invalid. The device may delete a point in every status.

allowedNow.description: Whether the device may capture and send live-sharing points right now.

nextEvaluationAt.description: When the answer may change by itself (a window opening or closing). The device asks again then.

validUntil.description: The device must stop sharing when this passes unless it has refreshed the policy. Null when not allowed.

consentRequired.description: True when the client allows sharing but the person has not agreed to the current disclosure.

disclosureVersion.description: The disclosure version the person must have seen. Send it with the consent.

clientId.description: The client this policy is for.

etag.description: Changes whenever the policy changes. Also sent as the ETag header; use it with If-None-Match.

heartbeatSeconds.description: How often a stationary device sends a point.

primaryType.description: The type the person chose (ALWAYS, SCHEDULE, ACTIVE_TRAVEL), or null.

schedule.description: The person's weekly windows in their local time, so the device can follow them offline.

oneOf.description: The event window (for example after an AEC) that is open now, or null.

sharingEnabled.description: Whether the client allows live sharing at all.

enabledTypes.description: The types the client offers. Empty when sharing is not enabled.

primaryType.description: ALWAYS, SCHEDULE or ACTIVE_TRAVEL. Must be one the client offers.

homeTimezone.description: Optional IANA zone used when the device does not report one.

schedule.description: Weekly windows. At least one is required for SCHEDULE. Kept when another type is chosen.

range.description: The requested range, one of 1h, 24h, 7d, 14d (capped at the retention window).

from.description: Start of the window actually applied.

partial.description: True when a source failed; the other sources are still returned.

failedSources.description: Names of the sources that failed.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

endTime.description: Local time, HH:mm. Before the start time means the window runs past midnight.
